candidate_source: exact frozen 1 m range-adaptive minPts=1 candidates
top_path: exact replay of frozen DP over the complete bag

silver_feasible_path.objective: lexicographically maximize silver-frame hits, then frozen cumulative DP score
silver_feasible_path.constraints: unchanged frozen graph pruning, dt, speed, acceleration, gap and duration rules
silver_feasible_path.warning: label-guided diagnostic path; not a deployable output and not independent GT

rank.definition: unique Viterbi edge-state winner paths within the silver span, sorted by frozen score
rank.limit: not an exact rank among the exponentially many non-winning raw paths
rank.lower_bound: 1 + number of qualifying edge-state winner scores strictly above the silver path score

legacy_revisit.coordinate_frame: provisional yaw-preserving leveled coordinates used by A-prime
legacy_revisit.cell_revisit_fraction: prior frames containing an input voxel in the same legacy cell / prior frames
legacy_revisit.neighborhood_revisit_fraction: prior frames containing an input voxel in any 3x3x3 neighbor cell / prior frames
legacy_revisit.background_probability: legacy static count before current frame / legacy frame_count after current-frame increment

feature_separation.comparison: silver-compatible UAV nodes versus top-clutter nodes at the same silver frames
feature_separation.statistics: pooled ROC AUC plus per-sequence median direction count; descriptive only
